releases.title: Private notebook backups
changes: Download saved passages and personal notes as a versioned JSON backup without uploading them.
Preview new entries, duplicates and conflicting notes before importing; keep existing notes unless replacements are selected.
Validate backup files and passage references, with safe handling of storage failures and stale previews.

releases.title: Paul's voyage to Rome
changes: Added a separate Voyage to Rome option with 22 passage-linked stages in Acts 27-28.
Extended the map to Italy with credited location markers, Malta wintering and reader, Atlas and index links.
Kept offshore passages, the storm and the shipwreck unpinned, with explicit source and location limitations.

releases.title: Consistent journey names
changes: Renamed Paul's journeys to Journeys of Paul across navigation, map labels, index links and the roadmap to match Journeys of Jesus.

releases.title: Clearer People Index icon
changes: Replaced the People, places & events navigation icon with a head-and-shoulders outline matching the existing style.

releases.title: Paul's missionary journeys
changes: Explore three missionary journeys in Acts through 61 passage-linked narrative stages, with 33 approximate location markers.
Use journey filters, a timeline, repeat visits and an accessible stage list, with links to the Bible reader, Atlas and People Index.
See source-linked geography and clear notes for regional, unnamed, offshore and disputed settings without invented routes or dates.
Updated the roadmap with the completed missionary journeys and Paul's voyage to Rome as the next geography milestone.

releases.title: Atlas passage preview
changes: Preview linked verses below the graph without changing its centre.
A second node click explicitly focuses the Atlas.

releases.title: Clearer one-hop Atlas connections
changes: Hovering an Atlas verse now softly highlights the directly connected verses and lines, one hop away.
The brighter shortest route to the centre remains distinct, with both highlight types identified in the legend.

releases.title: Reliable versioned deployments
changes: Corrected a deployment check that could prevent new website releases from publishing.
Kept release history, version numbers and update notes consistent across the site.

releases.title: Consistent version history
changes: Strengthened release checks so every website update receives a new version and public changelog entry.
Improved consistency between the public release history and the website footer version.

releases.title: Trace the shortest Atlas connections
changes: Hover over an Atlas verse to illuminate the shortest displayed route back to the centre in green.
See every verse and connection along the route, with a clearer route legend and unchanged navigation controls.

releases.title: Deep Scripture Connections
changes: Expanded passage-linked connection explanations to 115 and clarified editorial evidence status.
Added side-by-side Bible passage comparison with publisher-supplied text and attribution.
Introduced person-centred Scripture trails for eight major biblical figures.

releases.title: Explain Scripture connections in the Atlas
changes: Added passage explanations and context for selected quotations, parallels, echoes, typology and themes.
Made it easy to separate explained links from the wider community-ranked, unclassified reference archive.
Connected biblical people profiles to relevant Atlas explanations and original passage reading.

releases.title: Find more biblical people and kingdoms
changes: Expanded the People Index with over 100 further cited biblical figures, including major names from both Testaments.
Featured Hezekiah, David, Solomon, Moses, Paul and Assyria as directly selectable entries.
Improved search guidance, retry options and loading consistency across new releases.

releases.title: Explore Old Testament history and biblical kingdoms
changes: Added biblical people and event profiles from the ancestors of Israel to the Persian era.
Expanded the index with historical cities, ancient kingdoms, and sources distinguishing biblical narratives from archaeological records.
Added Hebrew Bible and Gospel filters and improved navigation between related Scripture entries.

releases.title: Explore biblical people, places and events
changes: Added searchable biblical people profiles with disambiguated names and passage references.
Connected 35 historical locations and 79 Gospel episodes to an interactive study index.
Added one-click navigation between the index, Bible reader, Connection Atlas and historical maps.

releases.title: Clarify Atlas evidence and validate Scripture references
changes: Explained that Atlas votes indicate community-ranked relevance rather than scholarly confidence.
Improved checks for Scripture citation ranges and made outstanding research-source gaps clearer.

releases.title: Clarify chronology evidence and citations
changes: Added academic reading links to the public Gospel evidence register for important ordering differences.
Clarified potentially parallel visits and the difference between narrative order and historical evidence.

releases.title: Compare Gospel narrative sequences
changes: Added individual Matthew, Mark, Luke and John passage-order views alongside the combined Journeys of Jesus timeline.
Added source-linked comparisons for disputed parallel accounts, and distinguished textual order from historical dates and travel.

releases.title: Complete historical release numbering
changes: Added sequential patch versions to earlier website updates, making the full release history easier to follow.
Aligned the public and development changelogs with the documented sequence of changes.

releases.title: Public release history and version display
changes: Added a compact, expandable website changelog to About Scripture Trails.
Show the current website version in the footer, with checks to keep future release numbers and notes in sync.

releases.title: Connection strength bars
changes: Replaced raw Atlas cross-reference vote labels with seven compact bars, scaled to the strongest connection for the selected verse.
Exact community vote counts remain available on hover and through accessible descriptions.

releases.title: Cleaner translation availability indicators
changes: Changed translation status badges into compact horizontal labels with green and red status circles.
Kept availability indicators display-only; choose translations in the Bible reader.

releases.title: Translation status made simpler
changes: Show translation availability without a separate configured state.
Report an edition as unavailable after a reading failure, then restore its available indicator after a successful reading.

releases.title: Official Scripture Trails website
changes: Established www.scripturetrails.com as the canonical site address, redirecting other domain variants.
Added individual availability indicators for ESV, NASB20, NIV and NKJV.

releases.title: Faster, locally hosted reference materials
changes: Moved the OpenBible.info cross-reference archive into locally served data files, with documented provenance.
Host credited city photographs on the site to reduce reliance on external image requests.

releases.title: Four in-page Bible translations
changes: Added NASB 2020, NIV 2011 and NKJV reading through authorised Bible services alongside ESV.
Keep a selected translation when sharing a passage or navigating; display publisher attribution with verses.

releases.title: Navigation and sidebar refinements
changes: Improved compact chapter navigation, sidebar scrolling and mobile-friendly presentation.
Made the Scripture Trails logo a link back to the homepage, and refined roadmap page spacing.

releases.title: Focused verse and chapter reading
changes: Show the requested verse or range instead of always displaying an entire chapter.
Added a Read full chapter action and improved reading links.

releases.title: More reliable historical images
changes: Improved image sourcing and fallbacks for historical locations, then moved credited photographs into local hosting.

releases.title: Historical city studies
changes: Added in-depth studies of Jerusalem, Nazareth, Capernaum, Bethlehem and Jericho.
Included Scripture references, historical and archaeological evidence, timelines, modern map illustrations and disputed-site comparisons.

releases.title: Evidence review and corrections
changes: Reviewed the Gospel journey episodes and historical place descriptions.
Published corrections, research limitations and differing Gospel chronologies instead of presenting uncertain details as established facts.

releases.title: Historical place dossiers and project roadmap
changes: Added biblical and historical source notes for the locations shown on the journeys map.
Launched a public roadmap to distinguish delivered features, upcoming work and research still needed.

releases.title: Journeys of Jesus map
changes: Launched an interactive map and timeline exploring 79 Gospel and Acts episodes across 35 places and regions.
Added passage links, visit history, filters and clear labels for uncertain sites and schematic routes.

releases.title: Expanded biblical cross-references
changes: Added attributed OpenBible.info links throughout the Bible, with ranking from community votes.
Separated imported references from curated quotation, parallel, echo and theme connections.

releases.title: Expanded Connection Atlas
changes: Added book, chapter and verse selection, plus exploration up to ten Scripture-reference hops.
Introduced verse-level links, readable graph depth controls and a fallback for neighbouring verses when no reference is known.

releases.title: More reliable Bible reference parsing
changes: Corrected duplicate Bible book aliases that could interfere with recognising Scripture references.

releases.title: First Scripture Trails release
changes: Introduced Bible reading, guided studies, bookmarks and personal notes stored on the current device.
Launched the original Scripture connection graph and light/dark site themes.
